title: A review's gate confirms are committed by the tool, so the orchestrator writes no KB-Work list by hand
goal: backlog.py answer --confirm (or a review command) commits the item files it changes with a KB-Work line naming exactly those items, as claim --commit and start --commit do; at SP-j2jn5ue4 the orchestrator's hand commit of four confirms was refused by the commit-msg hook twice (it named the review story, then space-separated ids) before the comma-separated list passed.
